changes.title: 2 dead, at least 1 missing after Grand Canyon hit by flash floods
changes.summary: Violent flash floods hit the Grand Canyon's Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area, causing "extensive damage" to the park's water infrastructure.

changes.title: 3 friends went hiking in the Grand Canyon. 1 died, 2 were reported missing.
changes.summary: At least two people were killed after flash floods swept through parts of Grand Canyon National Park over the weekend.

changes.title: US border patrol expected to aid Grand Canyon search for missing person
changes.summary: Nearly 80 people have been rescued, and two people confirmed dead, after flood hit national park A US border patrol technical search team is expected to deploy in the Grand Canyon, as authorities continue the search for at least one missing person after a fatal flash flood washed through the national park over the week.

changes.title: At least two dead as rescuers search for missing in Grand Canyon
changes.summary: Search teams have been working around the clock to locate more than a dozen people who are still unaccounted for after a devastating flash flood tore through the Grand Canyon on Saturday. NBC News’ Dana Griffin has the latest.

changes.title: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves 2 dead, others missing
changes.summary: Search and rescue teams have recovered two bodies following this weekend's flash floods in the Grand Canyon. The National Park Service says more than a dozen other people remain missing. Lodges and hotels are closed inside the park and more rain and flooding are possible. Ali Rogin reports.
